tagline: To build industry-changing solutions that create life-changing opportunities
hero_kpi_rationale: The backlog is the primary indicator of future demand in industrial equipment, reflecting visibility into short-term sales within a cyclical sector.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of orders received but not yet delivered.
kpis.description: Backlog reaches $514.1M, up 22.5%, supported by the acquisition of TerraSource and strong demand.
kpis.signal: Strong backlog growth, a positive signal for future sales.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from product and service sales.
kpis.description: Revenue reaches $1,410.4M, up 8.1%, driven by volume, pricing, and the TerraSource acquisition.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves to 26.5% (vs 25.1% in 2024), despite steel cost volatility.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement due to product mix and pricing.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin jumps to 4.7% (vs 1.0% in 2024), driven by an 184.1% increase in operating income.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement due to revenue growth and synergies.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Spending on acquisition or modernization of assets.
kpis.description: $151M spent as of end-2025 on the ERP program, out of a total expected cost of $180M to $200M.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Employee count is not mentioned in the provided documents.

kpis.name: TerraSource Sales
kpis.explanation: Contribution of sales from the acquired company TerraSource to consolidated revenue.
kpis.description: The acquisition of TerraSource generated $84.7M in incremental sales in 2025.
kpis.signal: Successful integration of a strategic acquisition.

kpis.name: ERP Costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to the deployment of the global ERP transformation system.
kpis.description: $151M spent as of end-2025 on the ERP project, which is expected to be completed in 2028 or 2029.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 1.41 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of 0.039 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: A 100 basis point change in interest rates could impact annual interest expense by $3.5 million. This represents a significant variation and justifies high severity.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: A 10% fluctuation in exchange rates could impact net sales by $17.7 million and net income by $1.1 million. This represents a significant variation and justifies high severity.

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in commodity prices, particularly steel, can impact production costs and profit margins. However, the company employs strategies to minimize this impact.

risks.title: Taxation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in tax laws or interpretations by tax authorities could impact the company's tax obligations. However, the company complies with current tax regulations.

risks.title: Revenue Recognition Risk
risks.score_rationale: Revenue recognition is a complex process requiring judgment and estimates. Errors or misinterpretations could impact financial statements.
